articles.title: Burnt out on a three-day week
articles.summary: Burnout is not always about doing too much. It can come from the gap between who you believe you are and how you are actually showing up at work.

articles.title: Forward-Deployed Everything
articles.summary: Forward-deployed teams only scale when customer-specific work becomes a reusable product. Turn field learning into repeatable workflows, or risk building a consulting business instead.

articles.title: Your product didn't get worse
articles.summary: AI can make good products feel outdated by raising customer expectations. Adapt to agent-driven workflows while preserving the value that keeps your product essential.

articles.title: Bullshit Management Didn't Die. It Got Automated
articles.summary: Shipping has become cheaper, but value is still hard. The advantage now comes from stronger judgment, not faster output.

articles.title: Product Manager, Applied AI at TLDR ($200k base + $60k bonus, Fully Remote)
articles.summary: TLDR is hiring its first PM to help build the agent-first operating layer used across the company. We’re looking for a builder who has shipped real products / systems with LLMs. Click here to learn more.

articles.title: What the Past Year Taught Meta
articles.summary: Judgment is becoming increasingly valuable. The next generation of PMs will stand out by knowing what to build and how to evaluate it.

articles.title: Don't Redesign Your Process Yet. Change Who Writes the Artifacts
articles.summary: Don't start agentic transformation by reinventing the process. Build a shared system that improves its own outputs, and keep humans focused on the decisions that matter most.

articles.title: What would the last software engineer still need to do?
articles.summary: AI makes implementation cheaper, so engineering judgment matters more. The best engineers will know what to build, why it matters, and what consequences come next.

articles.title: “Enshittification” Isn't Real
articles.summary: Platforms can feel worse when they stop optimizing for you. What looks like product decline may actually be a platform evolving around a broader set of users.

articles.title: Prediction: AI will collapse
articles.summary: AI's mass-market future probably is not coding agents.

articles.title: AI and the Recontextualization Tax
articles.summary: AI can eliminate much of the work of repackaging information for different stakeholders.
